scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../.. run gen-icons && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/preload.cjs
scripts.dev:raw: TENSAMIN_CHANNEL=dev pnpm run build:web && TENSAMIN_CHANNEL=dev pnpm run build && electron . --verbose
scripts.dev: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run dev:raw; else pnpm run dev:raw; fi
scripts.start: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run start:raw; else pnpm run start:raw; fi
scripts.package:raw: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run package:raw; else pnpm run package:raw; fi
scripts.package:linux:raw: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.package:linux: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run package:linux:raw; else pnpm run package:linux:raw; fi
scripts.package:windows:raw: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.package:windows: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run package:windows:raw; else pnpm run package:windows:raw; fi
scripts.validate:raw: pnpm run build && pnpm run package:linux:raw
scripts.validate: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop ../..#electron --command pnpm run validate:raw; else pnpm run validate:raw; fi
